data.name: Let's Bowl VR - Bowling Game
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Let's Bowl VR!


This is an amazing bowling game for virtual reality with realistic physics and cool graphics. It's a great way to surprise your friends and have fun with the company playing a classic bowling game without leaving your home.

The physical model of this game is very detailed. It simulates the real ballistics of bowling ball. So you can throw the ball over a complex envelope trajectory for best results, just like professionals do.

Be a part of the Bowling History starting with the end of the 19th century through different times up until present! Enjoy the game in a variety of bowling clubs from different towns around the world!

Coming soon — You can play the game in single player mode or over the network with other players! Play, win, earn rewards and achievements, share your progress with your friends and of course collect your unique professional bowling outfit!

Current version contains:

  • Core gameplay features are finished;
  • Arcade game mode is ready to play;
  • Career game mode is ready to play;
  • Challenges game mode in alpha access (available after finishing career mode);
  • Gameplay is smooth and well polished;
  • You can play bowling in 18 clubs from 5 cities!

Early Access

After release of patch 002 our main goal is to finish Challenges game mode to bring crazy fun to bowling game! Solve physical puzzles to win the challenges. Throw the balls via moving platforms, giant clown's head, circus tent and many other amazing obstacles!


And finally we will release crossplatform multiplayer game mode! Because it’s really fun to play this game with your friends and other players from around the world!

We prepared a lot of stuff to keep you entertained!

The full list of features for the release version (coming soon):

  • Enjoy 4 game modes: arcade, career, challenges and online tournament.
  • The career mode - become the world champion in bowling!
  • Up to 16 players online in tournament mode.
  • Play online on your own bowling lane without breaks.
  • Win tournaments and take prizes!
  • Earn achievements and take your place in leaderboards!
  • Buy new equipment and powerups, open extra levels for in-game currency!
  • Customize your equipment: set of balls and personal skittles.
  • Learn how to play with your personal bowling tutor Natasha!

reviews.review:
I really really wish I could sit down with the devs of this game and help them understand the ins and outs of bowling. As the game stands right now I would not call it real bowling. The game feels really good and looks really good however as of right now that is all it has. The cons of this games are
   -The physics of "hooking" the ball are completely off. A bowling ball does not hook as soon as it hits the lane as this game portrays, instead the ball hits the lane and slides beacuase there is oil on the lane which this games calls "reflection" in the graphics settings. Oil on the lane is very important to the sport of bowling.
   -This just might be me but the teleport function feels a litte wonky and seems to get me all turned around even when i try to make it face a certain way.

Other than that this game is fun to me and since I love the sport of bowling so much I really want to see this game improve and become a more realistic bowling game. Hopefully the devs are working hard on this game and are not in it just to make a quick buck. Giving this game a recomendation for the love of bowling however if you are expecting this game to be a bowling simulation then i would stay away.
